# TildaZ v0.9.3

**Tabs can be split into panes.**

- Split the active pane with `Ctrl+Shift` and an arrow (`Option+Cmd` on macOS) — the arrow
  picks the side the new shell lands on. Move the focus with `Alt`/`Cmd`+arrows and close
  one pane with `Ctrl+Shift+X` (`Shift+Cmd+X`). `Ctrl+Shift+Z` zooms a pane to the whole
  tab, `Shift+Alt+0` spreads them evenly, and the line between two panes can be dragged.
  ([#483](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/483))
- A plain click no longer starts a text selection: the pointer has to move about 4 pt (or
  into another cell) first, so a shaky click cannot copy a single character over your
  clipboard. ([#483](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/483))
- Alt combinations now reach the program on non-Latin keyboard layouts too — `Alt+n` sends
  `ESC n` on a Russian layout or a Korean input source instead of the layout's own letter.
  ([#533](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/533))
- On Linux, the IME candidate window for Hanja, Kanji and Hanzi follows the terminal cursor
  again on the default GPU render path, instead of staying pinned to the corner of the
  window. ([#535](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/535))

## Upgrade notes

**Your `config_N.toml` needs fifteen new `[keys]` actions for split panes.** The schema is
checked in both directions, so a file written by an older version stops the app with
`missing required key "focus_pane_left"` (or another of the fifteen). Move the file aside
(add `.bak` to its name), start TildaZ to get a fresh default file, then copy back the
values you had changed. ([#483](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/483))

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.9.3-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.9.3-1_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.9.3-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.9.3-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.9.3-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 14+ universal | `tildaz-v0.9.3-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; stable self-signed identity, not notarized. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.9.3-win-x64.zip` | Unzip and keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.9.3-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary; same layout as the x64 zip. |
